title: Hans Böckler Foundation: PhD Fellowship
summary: The Hans Böckler Foundation awards PhD fellowships to doctoral students with outstanding academic achievements who show commitment to labour unions or socio-political issues and are enrolled at a German higher education institution.

institutions.notes: State or state-recognised higher education institution in Germany

nationality.notes: No nationality restrictions mentioned in the text, open to international students who meet residence and admission requirements in Germany.

residence.notes: At the time of application, applicants must be a permanent resident of Germany.

mandatory.text: admission for doctoral studies at a state or state-recognised higher education institution in Germany
permanent resident of Germany at the time of application
commitment to labour unions or socio-political issues, ideally in the long term
responsible, motivated, reliable individuals willing to play an active role in the Foundation's work
age limit set at 40 years old
Knowledge of German must be proven by means of a B2 German language certificate (unless holding a German school leaving certificate or a Bachelor's degree in Germany)

exceptions.text: Applicants with a German school leaving certificate or a Bachelor's degree in Germany do not need to provide proof of German language.

funding.description: Doctoral students currently receive a grant of 1,750 EUR (1,650 EUR basic grant plus a research cost allowance of 100 EUR). In addition, they receive a health insurance subsidy of up to 100 EUR and, if applicable, a family allowance.

application_rounds.notes: Please find the updated deadlines at https://www.boeckler.de/de/bewerbungsfristen-2669.htm

steps.text: Please find all application forms and information on the online application procedure at https://www.boeckler.de/de/stipendium-fur-promovierende-2670.htm

sources.title: Hans Böckler Foundation: PhD Fellowship - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: The scholarship funds doctoral candidates studying/researching in Germany.
